title: Note Discipline
definition: The rule that every non-trivial Typed Link carries note text; the link type alone is not semantic payload. Absence is silent failure: cross-reference resolution depends on the note (C4 constraint 5). Small but binding; ADR-CANDIDATE-020.3.

links.note: constraint 2: schema validation rejects an unnoted non-trivial link; the only trivial type is references
the rule every non-trivial Typed Link satisfies
